
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19778151" title="发布于 2026-03-26 20:56">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Electron41+Vite8.0+DeepSeek桌面端AI助手|electron+vue3流式ai系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(204, 0, 255, 1)">2026年原创<span style="background-color: rgba(188, 250, 247, 1)">electron41+vite8+deepseek-chat</span>搭建本地客户端私人ai对话系统模板。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>vite8-electron-ai</strong>：基于<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 204, 255, 1)">Electron41+Vue3+Vite8+Arco+OpenAI</span>接入<strong>DeepSeek</strong>&nbsp;api实战电脑端从0-1打造你的专属AI搭子。支持<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">浅色+深色主题、深度思考、各种代码高亮/复杂/下载、katex公式、mermaid图表、多轮对话/本地存储会话</span>等功能。</span></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-p11" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326110042743-452217506.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326110116809-1958716695.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>技术知识</h3>
<ul>
<li>编辑器：VScode</li>
<li>跨平台框架：Electron^41.0.3</li>
<li>前端框架：vite^8.0.1+vue^3.5.30+vue-router^5.0.4</li>
<li>大模型框架：deepseek-v3.2+openai</li>
<li>组件库：arco-design^2.57.0</li>
<li>状态管理：pinia^3.0.4</li>
<li>markdown解析：markdown-it^14.1.1</li>
<li>打包工具：electron-builder^26.8.1</li>
<li>vite桥接electron插件：vite-plugin-electron^0.29.1</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="p3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326110347220-1486232802.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p3-2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326110436438-2020077981.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>功能支持性</h3>
<ol>
<li>内置<strong>light+dark</strong>主题</li>
<li>支持<strong>深度思考R1</strong>模式</li>
<li>支持<strong>Latex</strong>数学公式</li>
<li>支持<strong>Mermaid</strong>图表渲染（拖拽、缩放、下载）</li>
<li>支持代码块sticky浮动粘性、横向滚动、代码高亮/复制/下载代码</li>
<li>支持上下文多轮对话、本地存储会话</li>
<li>支持链接跳转、图片预览功能</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="360截图20260325000410395" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326110638274-1647034223.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3><em>electron41-vue3-deepseek桌面端ai系统已经正式更新到我的原创作品小铺，感谢支持！</em></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><a href="https://mall.bilibili.com/neul-next/detailuniversal/detail.html?page=detailuniversal_detail&amp;itemsId=40692803&amp;loadingShow=1&amp;noTitleBar=1#noReffer=true&amp;msource=merchant_share" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Electron41+Vite8+DeepSeek桌面版AI流式会话模板Exe</a></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="p1-1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326111004983-937423744.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目框架结构</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">使用最新版&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">electron41+vite8</span>&nbsp;搭建项目，调用<strong>deepseek-chat</strong>大模型，&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">vue3 setup</span>&nbsp;语法糖编码页面。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20260324234537590" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326111259907-482194387.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3><img alt="360截图20260325080241821" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326113639787-1399443304.png" class="lazyload"></h3>
<p><img alt="360截图20260325080511380" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326113653399-166298977.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="360截图20260325081439439" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326113757710-907505687.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目配置</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">将项目根目录下.env文件里的deepseek apikey替换为自己申请的key，即可体验丝滑流式对话功能。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">安装依赖&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">yarn install</span>&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">运行项目&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">yarn dev</span>&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">打包项目&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">yarn electron:build</span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="360截图20260324234727442" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326114040408-555551589.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>接入最新deepseek大模型</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">支持<strong>多轮对话、对话/推理模型、流式打字输出</strong>功能。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const completion =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await openai.chat.completions.create({
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单一会话</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> messages: [
    {role: 'user', content: editorValue}
  ], </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多轮会话</span>
  messages: props.multiConversation ? historySession.value : [{role: 'user'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, content: editorValue}],
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> deepseek-chat对话模型 deepseek-reasoner推理模型</span>
  model: sessionstate.thinkingEnabled ? 'deepseek-reasoner' : 'deepseek-chat'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  stream: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 流式输出</span>
  max_tokens: 8192, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 限制一次请求中模型生成 completion 的最大 token 数(默认使用 4096)</span>
  temperature: 0.4, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 严谨采样</span>
})</pre>
</div>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">setup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import { appState } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/pinia/modules/app</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  import Sidebar from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/layouts/components/sidebar/index.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  const appstate </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> appState()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<h3>入口配置</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createApp } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'./style.scss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App.vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { launchApp } from </span>'@/windows/actions'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入路由/状态配置</span>
import Router from './router'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import Pinia from </span>'./pinia'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入插件配置</span>
import Plugins from './plugins'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

launchApp().then(config </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(config) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储窗口配置</span>
    window.config =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> config
  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化app实例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  createApp(App)
  .use(Router)
  .use(Pinia)
  .use(Plugins)
  .mount(</span>'#app'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
})</span></pre>
</div>

<h3>自定义ai编辑框</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326115156884-593900256.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326115223530-200162169.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202603/1289798-20260326115254193-430871913.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="image"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icon-file-image </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span> 图片<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="file"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icon-file </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span> 本地文件<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="pdf"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icon-file-pdf </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span> PDF文档分析<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="page"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icon-cloud </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span> 网页总结<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-doption</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-dropdown</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-divider </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">direction</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vertical"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="margin: 0 15px 0 10px; height: 15px;"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="btn-submit"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="!sessionstate.loading"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="primary"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> shape</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="circle"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :disabled</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="!editorText?.trim() || sessionstate.loading"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> @click</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleSubmit"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icon-arrow-up </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">size</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="20"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="btn-submit"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> v-else type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="primary"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> shape</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="circle"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> @click</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleStopStream"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="background:#fff;border-radius:2px;height:10px;width:10px;"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a-button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>以上就是最新款electron41+vite8搭建本地桌面端专属ai系统的一些项目分享，希望对大家有点帮助！</p>
